<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import collections
def eye_bbox(fr):
    g=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    es=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='S']
    rs=[e[0] for e in es]; cs=[e[1] for e in es]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
for i in range(8):
    action(['UP'])
    r=last_action_result
    a=previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    bw=sum(1 for i2 in range(64) for j in range(64) if a[i2][j]=='B' and b[i2][j]=='W')
    print('UP#%d'% (i+1), 'changed:',r.get('board_changed'),'B->W:',bw,'eyes:',eye_bbox(current_frame),
          'lvl:',r.get('level_completed'),'done:',r.get('done'))
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over') or not r.get('board_changed'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
